rules.statement: For the purposes of section 338 of the Civil Procedure Code, 'estate below the value of Rs. 1,000' means a net estate after the deduction of secured debts.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think that the expression 'estate below the value of Rs. 1,000' in section 338 of the Civil Procedure Code has the same meaning as in the Stamp Ordinance."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 338 of the Civil Procedure Code
